source: Quiz 5 - Sessions 1-6: Model Training, Alignment, and the Agent Harness
question: Why should you avoid treating a token ID as the token's meaning?

options.text: It changes into a written definition when attention runs
options.feedback: Attention transforms numerical representations. It does not turn the index into dictionary text.

options.text: It is learned again whenever the token enters a prompt
options.feedback: Processing a prompt uses the token ID to select a representation. Ordinary inference does not relearn the model's weights on every token.

options.text: It indexes an entry with a numerical representation
options.feedback: The index performs a lookup role. The selected numerical representation, and its later transformations, support interpretation.

options.text: It contains the final representation after all blocks run
options.feedback: The ID is used at the start to select an embedding. It is not the final result of the model's processing.
